subject: curved-interface (2-D droplet) Young-Laplace calibration of the free-energy binary-fluid LBM against the analytic tension of the same free-energy functional

reference_provenance.free_energy_and_tension: Swift, Orlandini, Osborn & Yeomans, Phys. Rev. Lett. 78, 19 (1996); Briant & Yeomans & Yeomans PRE 69, 031602 (2004): f = A(-phi^2/2 + phi^4/4) + kappa|grad phi|^2/2, xi = sqrt(2 kappa/A), sigma = (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A) = (4/3) kappa/xi
reference_provenance.laplace_law: Young-Laplace: p_in - p_out = sigma (1/R1 + 1/R2); for the 2-D (cylinder) droplet one curvature => dp = sigma/R, NOT 2 sigma/R
reference_provenance.pressure_tensor_moment_balance: Rowlinson & Widom, J. Chem. Phys. 76, 1878 (1982): radial balance dP_rr/dr + (P_rr - P_tt)/r = 0 => dp = integral (P_rr - P_tt)/r dr, sigma = integral (P_rr - P_tt) dr
reference_provenance.surface_of_tension: Rowlinson & Widom (1982): R_sigma = integral r (P_rr - P_tt) dr / integral (P_rr - P_tt) dr -- the radius the Laplace law refers to in the sharp-interface limit

cases.protocol: static droplet, periodic box, populations advanced by the production kernel collide_and_stream; measures taken on the last step after the transient
cases.parameter_window: A=0.1, kappa=0.2 (xi=2, sigma=2/15) -- the window in which the explicit Cahn-Hilliard branch of this kernel is stable at dt=1 (measured: kappa>=0.29 diverges, see limitations)

meaning.C1_sigma_capillary_vs_analytic: headline KPI: |dp_mean * R_fit - sigma_analytic| / sigma_analytic <= 0.15 (owner standard; 0.03 stretch)
meaning.C2_sigma_integral_vs_analytic: independent route: sigma = integral (P_rr-P_tt) dr from the measured pressure tensor (one interface) vs analytic sigma
meaning.C3_tensor_capillary_vs_sigma_over_R: dp from the exact polar moment balance integral (P_rr-P_tt)/r dr vs sigma_analytic/R_sigma
meaning.C4_interface_width_recovered: atanh tanh-fit of the measured profile returns the model xi = sqrt(2 kappa/A)
meaning.C5_radius_definition_consistency: R_fit - R_contour stays below 0.35 cells (the diffuse interface has no unique radius; the report states which one the KPI uses)
meaning.C7_conservation: |Delta mean phi| and |Delta mean rho| <= 1e-8 over the run (rest populations f0 = rho - sum, g0 = phi - sum)
meaning.C2_sigma_integral_vs_discrete_reference: measured pressure tensor: sigma = integral (P_rr-P_tt) dr over one interface vs the SAME post-processing applied to the analytic tanh field at the measured R (cancels the nine-point stencil bias; the raw continuum comparison is reported too)
meaning.C3_tensor_capillary_vs_discrete_referenc: measured dp from the exact polar moment balance vs the same-pipeline analytic reference
meaning.C8_steady_window_noise: std/(|mean| sqrt(n)) of the dp samples inside the steady window <= noise_band

verdict_rule: PASS iff every analytic check and every per-case criterion holds; otherwise FAIL is reported per criterion (no aggregate cherry-picking, no post-hoc band widening). The 15 % owner band is the acceptance criterion; the 3 % stretch band is reported separately and never substituted for it.
known_limitations_declared_up_front: 2-D (cylinder) geometry: the 3-D sphere coefficient 2 sigma/R is NOT tested here.
The Laplace law is a sharp-interface limit: a finite xi/R correction of O((xi/R)^2) is expected and is reported as a trend over R/xi, not removed.

Only the parameter window in which this kernel's explicit Cahn-Hilliard branch is stable at dt=1 is graded; a wider kappa study is a separate mission (it needs the stability fix, not a criterion change).
The droplet is not allowed to dissolve: phi is conserved by construction, and the measured phi drift is reported (C7) rather than assumed.

The tensor routes are graded against a same-pipeline discrete reference because the nine-point stencil underestimates |grad phi|^2 by 5-16 % on a diffuse interface (R/xi = 9 -> 4.5); that bias is a post-processing property, quantified in discrete_reference_tension(), not a solver error.

measurement_protocol.declared: steady-window time average: the bulk pressure jump is sampled every averaging_every steps inside the trailing steady_window and the mean enters the KPI; the single-snapshot value is reported as a noise diagnostic
measurement_protocol.reason: measured single-snapshot scatter of dp is +-10..30 % step-to-step on this model, which is larger than the 3 % stretch band
measurement_protocol.noise_gate: C8: relative standard error of the time mean <= noise_band (2 %)

parameter_window: A=0.1, kappa=0.2 (xi=2, sigma=2/15), Gamma=0.05, tau_f=1.0, tau_phi=2.0 -- the window measured to be stable for this kernel; tau_phi=1.0 diverges at step ~350 and Gamma>=1.0 diverges immediately at N=48..96 (measured 2026-11-15, supersedes the earlier claim that kappa>=0.29 is the stability limit)
